fasteners.body: Internally accessed M3 through-bolts with washers and M3 nyloc nuts through matched flange tabs
fasteners.ear: Two internally accessed M3 through-bolts with washers and M3 nyloc nuts per matched ear-root tab pair
fasteners.threadlocker: medium-strength removable threadlocker only on metal-to-metal threads

deferred: removable rear service cover and gasket
review_notes: Gate 5 is a full-size internal flange-tab candidate and must be physically validated with a 100 mm assembly and full-size coupons before production printing.
Each matching flange-tab pair and every light triangular rib on an internal source-panel connection is printed as part of its shell; Gate 5 exports no separate printed joiners.

Triangular internal panel ribs are limited to left_lower_face, left_upper_head, right_lower_face, and right_upper_head. They do not run along inter-shell flange seams, outer edges, the rear base, or either ear.
All M3 through-bolts, washers, and loose nyloc nuts are inside the head; the approved exterior has no fastener holes.
The rear-base section includes the 100 x 80 mm service opening and an integrated internal rim so final internal fasteners remain reachable.
The bike connector flange and rail load path remain deferred.
